phase_0_d1_setup.notes: Session 1 (2026-08-30): D1 database clipforge-bot-state (id 720de60e-1a08-492a-9ce6-64cb9534098d, region WNAM) created; bot/migrations/0001_initial.sql (task_labels, task_options, clone_jobs, announcements) applied remotely — verified via sqlite_master query listing all 4 tables live. CLIPFORGE_BOT_D1 binding added to bot/wrangler.bot-a.jsonc (migrations_dir=migrations) and deployed to clipforge-bot-a (version 820ff912-9e81-4515-bc08-25747301bbad); Bot B config deliberately untouched. PRE-EXISTING BLOCKER FIXED on the way: tickCloneJob in bot/src/index.js declared `const job` then reassigned it (lines ~201/216), which failed esbuild and made EVERY Bot A deploy impossible — changed to `let` with a load-bearing comment. SELECT 1 against the live DB succeeded.

phase_1_task_labels.notes: Session 1 (2026-08-30): ensureTaskLabel/setTaskOptions/getTaskOptions/getJobIdForLabel/removeTask/taskLabels (+ markTaskSeen/isTaskSeen) rewritten against CLIPFORGE_BOT_D1 (task_labels + task_options tables). bug-2 lowest-free-label logic preserved verbatim over SQL (SELECT label set -> lowestFreeLabelIndex -> INSERT); the legacy monolithic user:<id>:tasks KV blob and its `next` high-water hint are gone. `seen` intentionally NOT removed yet (phase 4 scope) — it still flows through options_json unchanged. Test harness: bot/test/helpers/d1.mjs implements the Workers D1 API (prepare/bind/all/first/run/batch) on node:sqlite with the REAL migrations SQL as schema; tasks.test.mjs ported to it (KV stub retained only for credentials). scripts/reclaim-stale-task-labels.mjs ported from wrangler kv key list/get/put to wrangler d1 execute (same classify/seriesIncomplete decision lib, bug-62/66/67 logic untouched). npm test: 140/140 pass.

phase_2_clonejob.notes: Session 1 (2026-08-30): getCloneJob/putCloneJob/deleteCloneJob/listCloneJobChatIds rewritten against the clone_jobs D1 table. AES-256-GCM PAT envelope + per-chat AAD via crypto.js UNCHANGED (same encryptCredentials at put, decryptCredentials at get, same envelope field) — storage backend only. The clonejobid KV index key + CLONE_JOB_INDEX_KEY scan set are deleted: a row's existence in clone_jobs IS the sweep's scan set, so listCloneJobChatIds is `SELECT chat_id FROM clone_jobs` and the dead index-maintenance code is gone. putCloneJob upserts ON CONFLICT(chat_id). tickCloneJob/runCloneJobSweep in index.js (bug-51 cron path) call the same function names with the same shapes — no caller change needed; the `let job` fix from phase 0 keeps that module buildable. clone-jobs.test.mjs ported to makeD1() with an added upsert regression test; KV stub dropped (accidental KV access now fails loudly). npm test: 141/141 pass.

human_review_items: Pre-existing deploy-blocker found on origin/main before migration work: tickCloneJob (bot/src/index.js) used `const job` + reassignment, so no Bot A build/deploy could succeed. Fixed to `let` as a prerequisite of phase 0's deploy gate. This bug predates the migration and affected ALL prior deploy attempts, not just D1 work.
